target.description: Read-only adversarial review of the accepted Source Universe substrate, the permanent Source Vault bootstrap process, and the Source Universe to Methodological Knowledge Universe provenance boundary before the first permanent private registry/vault write.

known_exposures: Foundation 022, Research 034 and Specification 023 already define and accept the current Source Universe substrate.
The first VU Machine Learning source corpus already passed the bounded source-substrate validation campaign.
The permanent Source Vault bootstrap has not yet performed the user's real permanent private registry/vault write.
The project intends the Source Universe to preserve durable evidence while the Methodological Knowledge Universe contains reusable interpreted methodological knowledge.
The normal Claude Project has full repository access through a custom connector; Claude Code remains available separately for later local execution-based verification and deployment work.

Before the substantive review began, the project owner requested an explicit Claude-vs-Claude-Code environment assessment; the resulting recommendation was normal Claude for the read-only architecture/repository review and Claude Code only for later targeted execution evidence where required.
independence.notes: This is a direct adversarial review of an existing accepted candidate, not a blind independent design exercise. Normal Claude should challenge defects and unnecessary complexity without treating difference from the existing architecture as a goal. The frozen review target remains unchanged. If the review identifies claims that genuinely require local execution evidence, preserve them explicitly for a separately scoped Claude Code or other execution-agent verification task rather than expanding MC-0006 into deployment work.

last_transition.reason: Before substantive review began, the project owner clarified that normal Claude already has full repository access through a custom connector and requested an explicit environment comparison. Claude recommended normal Claude for the read-only architecture/repository review, with Claude Code reserved for later narrow execution-based verification and local deployment. MC-0006 therefore changes only reviewer provenance; the exact frozen target and blocking boundary remain unchanged.
